item.elsewhere.galvanic_coilmail.lore1: Full set, Capacitor: each hit you take stores a charge (max 5, fades after 8 s)
item.elsewhere.galvanic_coilmail.lore2: Your next melee hit discharges into up to 3 other mobs within 4 blocks: 2 damage per charge, ignores armor
item.elsewhere.galvanic_coilmail.lore3: No knockback resistance; lightning hurts you more (+12.5% per piece); slow Mending
item.elsewhere.galvanic_upgrade_smithing: Diamond armor + Storm Coil: Galvanic Coilmail
item.elsewhere.ironclad_flail.lore1: Hits on the same target within 2 s chain: +10% each, up to +50%
item.elsewhere.ironclad_flail.lore2: A miss or a new target resets the chain
item.elsewhere.ironclad_flail.lore3: No Sweeping Edge; 20% slower while moving backward
item.elsewhere.ironclad_chain.lore1: Thurgrim's flail chain. Smithing: diamond sword + Skyiron
item.elsewhere.gale_rapier.lore2: Sprinting hit: +3 lunge damage and a short dash
item.elsewhere.gale_rapier.lore3: -25% damage while standing still; no Sweeping Edge; frail
item.elsewhere.mirrorbolt_arbalest.lore2: Bolts pierce 3 mobs (built in, so it takes Multishot)
item.elsewhere.mirrorbolt_arbalest.lore3: 2.5 s reload; spends arrows, no Infinity, no fireworks
item.elsewhere.heliodor_mirror_core.lore: Heliodor's focusing mirror. Crafts the Mirrorbolt Arbalest
item.elsewhere.steam_auger.lore1: 2.5x netherite pickaxe speed on stone, ores and deepslate
item.elsewhere.steam_auger.lore2: Burns 1 coal or charcoal from your inventory per 100 blocks
item.elsewhere.steam_auger.lore3: 2-block reach; no Fortune, no Mending (too hot)
item.elsewhere.steam_auger_bit.lore1: From Thurgrim's forge. Smithing: diamond pickaxe + Skyiron
item.elsewhere.termite_hive_lantern.lore: Mine a block and the termites eat the 3x3 face around it over 2 s
Dirt, wood, mud and stone only, at 1/3 netherite pickaxe speed
Termites chew your builds if you aim wrong; useless on ores
item.elsewhere.termite_queen.lore1: Found in Mother Creak's bark. Crafts the Termite Hive Lantern
item.elsewhere.seers_hourglass.lore1: Trinket (off hand or hotbar, 2 active at most)
item.elsewhere.seers_hourglass.lore2: Boss attack hints appear for you; boss warnings come 0.15 s earlier
item.elsewhere.seers_hourglass.lore3: Takes a trinket place; does nothing outside boss fights
item.elsewhere.prospectors_pendulum.lore: Trinket: swings toward the nearest ore within 24 blocks
Use in hand: names up to 2 ore types and their distance
Never finds diamond or ancient debris; wears out
item.elsewhere.void_tether_spool.lore1: Sneak + use: set the anchor. Use: snap back to it
item.elsewhere.void_tether_spool.lore2: Works within 64 blocks, in the same dimension
message.elsewhere.steam_auger.cold: The Steam Auger is cold: carry coal or charcoal
message.elsewhere.void_tether_spool.dime: The tether can't reach across dimensions
message.elsewhere.void_tether_spool.far: Too far from the anchor (%s blocks max)
message.elsewhere.void_tether_spool.hung: Too hungry to pull the tether (needs 4 hunger points)
item.elsewhere.amberstill_plate.lore1: Full set, Brace: after 2 s without sprinting
item.elsewhere.amberstill_plate.lore2: +4 toughness (12, like netherite); hits keep it, sprinting breaks it
item.elsewhere.amberstill_plate.lore3: Only 8 toughness while sprinting; slow Mending; not fire-proof
item.elsewhere.amberstill_upgrade_smithi: Diamond armor + Amber ingot: Amberstill Plate
